info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Lock Box Retrieval API
info.description: The Cheque Lock Box Retrieval API provides developers with access to cheque lock box details for specific banking transactions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information related to cheque management and storage, enhancing visibility into trade banking operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking professionals who need to manage and oversee cheque deposits effectively. With this API, developers can streamline their cheque processing workflows and improve customer service.

get.description: This operation allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific cheque lock box identified by its resource ID. Use this endpoint to access the locks, cheques, and related details pertaining to the cheque lock box.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary parameters to retrieve details about a specific cheque lock box under the Trade Banking service. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema to receive the appropriate response.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the response contains the requested data.
